summary.text: Nathan Johnson is the Democratic nominee. A Dallas attorney and mediator, he has been a state senator since 2019 and says he has passed 134 bills across water, energy, education, health care and criminal justice. He campaigns on investigating corruption in the public and private sectors, consumer protection and antitrust enforcement, partnering with district attorneys, and suing the federal government over what he calls unconstitutional border policy.

paragraphs.text: Johnson holds a bachelor's degree in physics from the University of Arizona and a law degree from the University of Texas.
He practices trial litigation and dispute resolution as a litigator and mediator with the firm Thompson Coburn in Dallas.
Johnson was first elected to the Texas Senate in 2018 and has served since 2019, representing District 16 in Dallas County.
He is the Democratic nominee for attorney general in the November 3, 2026 general election.
